title_text: Three non-cubical applications of extension types

Inline.Text: The development of cubical type theory inspired the idea of “extension types” which has been found to have applications in other type theories that are unrelated to homotopy type theory or cubical type theory. This article describes these applications, including on records, metaprogramming, controlling unfolding, and some more exotic ones.
